screens.title: 1 · The day, said and drawn
screens.why: Dates are resolved by the server; a wrong day shows before Aplicar.

pins.label: Facts, not guesses
pins.text: Steps are the server's facts: what 'amanhã' is, which card 'o dentista' matched (by short ref, never a UUID). Same ticked line as today.

pins.label: Header = resolved day
pins.text: The card's header is the day the change lands on, in words.

pins.label: Both days on a cross-day move
pins.text: When a move changes day, both ends name it (sáb 16:00 → dom 09:00); same-day moves stay hour-only.

screens.title: 2 · Between = a drag
screens.why: Every agent change is a gesture the person could make by hand.

pins.label: A place, not an hour
pins.text: A 'place' change says where in the queue (entre Academia e Jantar) instead of 'nova tarefa'. No anchor: it moves with the queue like a dragged card.

pins.label: Pushes from the dry run
pins.text: What it pushes comes from running the plan on an in-memory copy of the day with the same code Aplicar runs, so plan and apply can't disagree.

pins.label: Named default
pins.text: Anything taken without being told (length, today, end of queue) is a quiet line with the pen, right above Ajustar. Never silent.

screens.title: 3 · A doubt, asked once
screens.why: The server spots the duplicate; the agent asks before any plan.

pins.label: Duplicate caught in code
pins.text: A 'new' card whose title matches one in the horizon blocks the plan. No plan card: the question replaces it.

pins.label: Quick replies
pins.text: Each pill carries its own plan; a tap applies it with no other model call. Neutral ink, no accent: equal choices. Once taken, it becomes one ticked line.

pins.label: Free text stays
pins.text: The composer is the fallback. How often a doubt is answered here instead of a tap is logged: it tells us the options missed.

screens.title: 4 · No hour given
screens.why: Suggest from facts and ask; nothing implicit is applied.

pins.label: Why this hour
pins.text: The facts behind the proposal (free room, nothing similar today) are the steps; the reply says why and asks 'Pode ser?'.

pins.label: One call
pins.text: A clean plan ends the turn: the model writes this reply inside propose_plan, so 3 model calls become 1.

pins.label: Deixar para depois
pins.text: The backlog is a quick reply under the card, not a silent default. Aplicar keeps the accent.

screens.title: 5 · Honest errors
screens.why: Each failure says what it was, and the way out.

pins.label: Typed failure
pins.text: Model down, empty answer, refusal (server's words), day moved on, offline, or ours: each its own Portuguese line. The server retries once before this.

pins.label: Tentar de novo
pins.text: Resends the last request; hidden for a refusal, where retrying gives the same answer.

pins.label: Detalhes
pins.text: Reveals the turn's trace code, selectable, for a bug report.
